> High-level asks:

> - Recording + transcript retained for 90 days — need clarity on retention and who can access

Proposal from our side:
- Staggered windows to reduce cross-region friction: host two identical 90m sessions on Jan 19 at 10:00 PST and Jan 20 at 08:00 PST. That gives an East Coast-friendly and a more APAC-friendly option without stretching folks.
- Run-of-show (high level): 0–5m intro + business update, 5–65m roadmap demo (recorded live), 65–90m ops deep dive + Q&A. We’ll add a 5-minute buffer after 90m for capture completion.
- Transcription fallback: we’ll enable live ASR with per-session fallback — if livestream fails, attendees get immediate near-real-time captions and we’ll attach the generated transcript to the recording. We keep transcripts in your tenant for 90 days by default; we can extend retention if you’d like.

Action items for smooth scheduling:
1) Confirm preferred single session (pick one of the two) or ask us to run both.
2) Confirm recording/PII policy — who at Ellipsis should have access to the raw transcript?
3) Approve run-of-show draft; Marissa is the owner for ops (cc’d) and Jordan will handle the recording + streaming configuration.

I’ve attached an outline we’ll use to draft the run-of-show and a short doc on the transcription fallback.
